notes.title: Galactic Glitch v1.4 - Corrupted Reality Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/fdaa360e2184df37b8e85c1699dc2683967f82f6.png

Hey everyone!

It's that time again! The Corrupted Reality update is here! A huge update spanning all kinds of different areas of the game! This is, by far, our biggest update since 1.0, adding a new difficulty level, new weapons, new bosses, new mechanics, new story beats, more powers, more room types, and a whole new story character (you'll meet her soon...)!

We've also added features many of you have been asking for, like the Power Library in the hub where you can select which powers are active for your next run, and minion reviving, which makes those summon powers much more useful, especially in long fights against big bosses.

New Content

 Boss Orb 4 - A new difficulty tier with an upgraded final boss encounter
 New Mechanics: - Take in the new [spoiler]corrupted powers[/spoiler], if you dare!
 New Character: Meet [spoiler]Symera[/spoiler] !
 New Weapons: Three awesome new guns to unlock!
 New Room types: Many new rooms types, like new shops and hidden rooms
 New Music: Many areas now feature completely new music tracks
 New Bosses: All early game areas got new bosses and variants to fight and defeat!
 Power Library - Choose which powers appear in your runs
 Minion Wrecks - No minion left behind! You're now able to revive fallen comrades!
 Game Mode Selection - Select your game mode when starting new game files
 Better progression - Guaranteed Power unlocks after won runs
 Clearer completion - Completion marks on prototypes now clearly show what you've accomplished

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/d5bd94472de25e2b02ae71b37e8f4f129d3aaf82.png

Gameplay & Balance

 Rebalanced all difficulty levels, for better progression
 Glitched enemy HP boost reduced for better balance
 Shop prices are now consistent (no more variance)
 Buffed various powers and weapons (Firefly, Railgun, Quantum Beam, and more)
 Enhanced boss health bar animations
 And tons of additional improvements and fixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/1a48f57f7d8996c85357164b49f597bf1460c4f0.png

This update has been months in the making, and it's all based on your feedback. Thank you so much to everyone that has been sharing their opinions and feedback on the forums and Discord!

We really hope you enjoy all the new content, and we're looking forward to hearing what you think of all the new content and changes!

Enjoy the update!
- Max and the GG team

notes.title: Galactic Glitch 1.0 Timeline Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to give you a quick update on our plans for the full 1.0 release of Galactic Glitch, which is coming in about one month from now!

First off, we want to say thanks to all of you for making our Early Access journey so awesome. We're super happy with our over 200 reviews and 91% positive rating! The EA period has been great for getting tons of feedback that helped us improve the game even further. You guys are the best!

We're adding a lot of new things in 1.0, starting with lots new content to deepen the experience:

New levels with unique mechanics
More enemies and bosses to challenge your wits and skill
More weapons with different attack styles to build up your arsenal
More Powers to create your own customized and crazy powerful builds
A completely revamped and updated HUD

We're also rebalancing the game's difficulty and progression completely, with a much stronger focus on Roguelike fans, who enjoy a deeper challenge. In exchange for upping the difficulty we've also increased some options of creating awesome builds, meaning that you'll need to think and plan to craft a truly powerful build. And you'll definitely need it to succeed in your goal, of escaping the simulation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/6f5519ce40e192547256b49f13aec639d72672d3.png
Besides the new content and updated progression, there will also be completely new features and mechanics in the game. One of those new feature is actually one that many EA players have been asking for: Unique starter ships! 

The way it works: You'll be able to find and capture many wild and abandoned prototype ships which Siren created in the past, on her previous escape attempts. Once captured and returned to the Hub, you'll be able to tame and control them, and then swap them in as your own. Each of these prototypes will have unique stats and characteristics and will make for very different runs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/e7fa53e3b01ae13044f232fe5e1ab90ddc6e586d.gif

We think these new starter ships will be an awesome addition to the game, and will offer you many new and exciting ways to plan and execute your builds on each run!

Now on to some orga stuff:

Beta Phase
We're planning a beta phase about a week before release (so in about 3 weeks from now), which will be available to all EA players. This is your chance to jump into the new content early and try out all the new goodies the game has to offer, before everyone else jumps in!

Price Update
With the full release approaching, we'll be increasing the price of Galactic Glitch to 14.99 USD/EUR in the next days. If you've been thinking about jumping in, now's the perfect time to grab the game at its Early Access price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/ae9029d130dde0c92082f686266373d23e6c5e9f.gif

We can't wait to show you everything we've been working on! Join us on Discord or write to us on the forums with your thoughts. And if you're enjoying the game, feel free to leave a review! It helps us reach more players and grow our awesome community!

Discord: https://discord.gg/6jPYbpZa2g

Happy glitching!
The Galactic Glitch Team

notes.title: Update v.509 - Reworked Weapons System and Upgrades
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/a93b7cb611e5a4c345656104e33556662120a839.png

Hey everyone!

As promised in our last post, we're back with the Weapons Update! This includes a reworked weapons system based on our community's feedback that the Weapon Evolution system was not working well. You guys told us loud and clear that you preferred being able to select your preferred weapon at the start of the run again, so we listened and brough it back.

During the run, each starting weapon will be upgradable twice. These upgrades won't change the mechanics of the gun anymore, and instead only focus on improving that weapons core stats. So instead of worrying about weapon changes, this update will put the focus back on Powers and finding those perfect combinations that make each build and each run special.

We've also added the first iteration of the Weapon Blueprint system. Before unlocking new weapons in the Hub, you'll now need to gather the weapon's blueprint, which is dropped from enemies in different levels. This way, we want to avoid the feeling of rushing through all the weapon unlocks, and not having the time to get used and try each new weapon.

Here's what's new in this update:

 Removed the Weapon Evolution system (based on your feedback!)
 Added a Weapon Upgrader in Glitchspace
 Added back 12 starter weapons (many more coming with release)
 Each weapon now has 2 upgrade levels
 Gather Blueprints during runs to unlock them in the Workshop

As some players requested, we've also added a dynamic camera zoom during intense combat, so you won't be hit (as often) from offscreen anymore! Thanks skippydog

We want to thank you all again for the constructive feedback that led to these changes. Your input is what helps make Galactic Glitch better with each update. As always, if you encounter any issues or have thoughts about these changes, please let us know on the forums or our Discord.

Enjoy the improved weapon system, and keep glitching!

notes.title: Upcoming Weapons Update and 1.0 Release Plans
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to give you a quick update on what we're working on. Over the last few weeks, we've received lots of feedback about the Weapon Evolution system - and we heard you loud and clear! While some of you enjoyed the variety it brought, many of you mentioned that it wasn't fun to change weapons mid-run, especially when you have a favorite weapon you'd rather stick with.

To address this feedback, we decided to create a small in-between update, while we also keep working on the next big one. In this smaller update, we're actually going to remove the Weapon Evolution system that was added with the last update. Instead, we're going to replace it with a more streamlined Weapon Upgrade system, which we think will fit the game's design goals better, and will also address the feedback you've been sharing.

So what's going to change in this update?
With this new system, we will add back the Armory and Weapon Store in the Hub. This way, you'll be able to select your preferred weapon at the start of the run again. During the run, each starting weapon will be upgradable twice. These upgrades won't change the mechanics of the gun anymore, and instead only focus on improving that weapons core stats, like less chargeup and cooldown for projectile-based weapons like the Quickshot, shorter ticks between damage and more range for beam-based weapons like the Stabilized Quantum Beam, or a larger area of effect for the Void Ring.

So instead of worrying about weapon changes, this update will put the focus back on Powers and finding those perfect combinations that make each build and each run special. 

We're aiming to have this update ready within the next week or two.

And what about the next big update?
While we're doing this smaller update in between, we're also working on a much bigger update. In fact, our next major update will be "the big one" - our full release! This update will bring all-new levels, enemies, and bosses, and some exciting new mechanics that will give you more choice in your builds, and in how to maximize the run in the way they want. 

You'll be able to play it safe and slow, fast and furious, or anything in between. Our goal is to give you a lot more influence in how each run develops, and what combo of crazy upgraded Powers you want to smash your enemies with. We can't wait to show you all of this, and it will be coming to Steam in Q1 2025.

Early Feedback and Testing
We're also planning to run a beta phase before the full release, in early 2025. If you're interested, sign up for our mailing list at https://www.galacticglitch.space/ and we'll reach out to you when the time comes!

Thanks again for all your feedback and support. We're looking forward to getting these weapon ugprades into your hands, and hearing what you think!

Talk to you soon, and keep glitching!

Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to announce our biggest update since launch - "Evolution Unleashed: The First Major Content Update"! This update brings a ton of new content and game-changing mechanics that we can't wait for you to experience.

First off, we're expanding the universe with three brand new levels:

 The Celestial District A bustling area filled with cars, trucks, and lots of police. Get ready for some urban action!
 The Fractured Frontier A harsh battleground where insectoids and humans are locked in struggle. Will you help hold back the insectoid surge or let your enemies take each other out?
 The Outer Sphere A high-tech area packed with new challenges and advanced enemies

But that's not all - we're introducing an exciting new Weapon Evolution system! Now, instead of unlocking weapons with Orbs, you'll upgrade and evolve your weapons over the course of your run. It's a whole new way to create your own unique build and attack each run your way.

And there's a lot more packed into this update. We've added 16 new enemies, 2 new mini-bosses, over 20 new upgradable powers, 3 unique weapons, completely revamped character art, and improved vfx and visuals for many enemies and effects.

Here's a full breakdown of what's new:

 3 new levels, each with unique mechanics and atmosphere
 16 new enemies to test your skills
 2 new mini-bosses to challenge your abilities
 More than 20 new powers, all upgradable for more strategic options
 New Weapon Evolution Mechanics - watch your weapons grow stronger as you progress

notes.title: Adding Mid-Run Saves and lots more - Update v0.130
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115932/cd5f95513a4477cb29cf910e7305f0800cc7bc40.png

Hey everyone!

It's been a few weeks since our last update, and we're back with a big one! This one includes some much requested features like mid-run saves and boost direction settings, as well as some nice gameplay improvements like much better hit feedback on enemies, and enemy rip-able parts being a lot more fun to use!

Your runs will now be saved at the start of each level, so you can take breaks during longer runs without losing progress. Boost direction now defaults to keyboard input instead of mouse, and there's a setting for it in the controls menu. Enemy hit effects are now way more noticable, and should make it much easier to see enemies' subparts, for easier targeting and ripping them clean off!

There's a ton more improvements and we've squashed a bunch of bugs too, like issues with windowed mode, players getting stuck, and weird power and enemy behaviors. Check out the full list of changes below!

Improvements

 Added Mid-Run Saves, at the start of each level
 Improve all enemy hit effects, for better visuals and sub-part clarity
 Improved ripable enemy weapon parts, to start firing faster when grabbed
 Added option for Boost direction, to follow keys or mouse input
 Update Pitch and Patch Power, now marks one enemy per room
 Improved map input, movement is now on right mouse button
 Improve Performance issues on some beam and fire weapons
 Updated sprites on some enemies in Scrapyard and Shattered Frontier levels
 Updated sprites and logic for Station mini-boss in Armory level
 Updated sprites on some enemies in Asteroid Fields
 Improved many AOE effects for better clarity and look
 Improve Power Upgrade input feedback
 Added input sprites for Steam Deck

Balance Changes

 General tweaking of hitboxes and hit effects, for clarity and better hit feedback
 General increase of enemy weapon parts firing rate when grabbed
 Reduce hitpoints and firing rate on CannonEnemy (the red guy in Armory level)
 Tweak Testudo, add 2nd hitbox in rear, increase appearance on Forge level
 Added enemy sub-bullets doing friendly fire damage to other enemies
 Reduce Shocktrooper sniper projectile speed and startup time
 Tweak Armory wave graphs, removed Spotter as spawned enemy
 Increased SpiderEnemy AOE sizes and added clearer effect
 Increase Insect Queen subpart sizes
 Tweak Shattered Reaches mini-boss
 Reduced enemy health buffs on higher NG+ levels

Bug Fixes

 Fixed Windowed mode getting reset
 Fix Scrapyard mini-boss bullets not despawning
 Fixed hardened hull icons could appear too frequently
 Fixed multipart enemies connected with joints could behave weirdly after death
 Fixed Player rarely can't collect Area Cleared Bonus
 Fixed unlocking new weapon didn't trigger save
 Fix player getting stuck inside enemies
 Fixed rare particles issue with Chain Lightning

 Fix GravShocker Power trigger
 Fix Squatter enemy blocking gates

 Fixed Revenge power didn't work with collision damage
 Fixed Upgrade tree interaction with already activated node
 Fixed layout of Save Slots
 Fixed upgrades achievement triggered too early

We're planning to push out a few smaller hotfixes over the next week to catch any remaining issues. After that, we'll start focusing on the next big content update, which we're planning to release in mid to late autumn.

As always, we love hearing from you! Please keep sharing your thoughts, reporting any bugs you find, and letting us know what you want to see in future updates. You can reach us on our Discord server or through the Steam forums.

notes.title: Balance Patch - Patch Notes v0.103
notes.notes:
We're making some balancing changes based off of initial player feedback.

A lot of players and streamers have mentioned that the game currently felt a bit too easy and sluggish, especially in the early sections. 

We've now rebalanced those sections to make the enemies' attacks more challenging, while also reducing their hp somewhat. This should make the early game quicker and more dynamic. It will require players to pay attention and learn the enemy patterns, to make it through the first levels safely.

We're very curious to hear what you think of the change! Give it a spin and let us know your thoughts!

Change notes:

 Rebalance enemies in early levels for better challenge
 More damage buff from purple Upgrade Protocol

Thanks for your feedback: Lmaonaise and shnooberk on our Discord and to Tyrian Mollusk on Steam!
